build_metric: build a MetricCollection for a given MetricType like mean_accuracy or multiclass_f1 with num_classes
build_topk_accuracy_metric: build a top-k accuracy MetricCollection with micro, macro, or none averaging for multiclass classification
build_topk_imagenet_real_accuracy_metric: build a top-k ImageNet ReaL accuracy MetricCollection for real-world multi-label evaluation
ImageNetReaLAccuracy_update: update the ImageNetReaLAccuracy metric with prediction tensors and multi-label target tensors
ImageNetReaLAccuracy_compute: compute the mean top-k accuracy from accumulated true positives in ImageNetReaLAccuracy
